diagnostics.measurement: independent property intensities 0..5; explicit pole statuses; no subtraction or invented antonyms
diagnostics.missing_policy: unknown is NaN, never zero; iteratively filter scales before objects until stable; training gaps mean-imputed; posterior uses only observed coordinates
diagnostics.minimum_coverage_policy: each iteration: first scales observed on at least 60% and 8 current objects and nonconstant; then objects observed on at least 60% and 4 surviving scales; repeat until stable; retained overall coverage at least 75%
diagnostics.preprocessing_report: На каждой итерации сначала исключаются постоянные шкалы и шкалы, измеренные менее чем у 60% текущих объектов или менее чем у 8 объектов. Затем исключаются объекты с оценками менее чем по 60% оставшихся шкал или менее чем по 4 шкалам. Процедура повторяется до стабильности состава. В итоговой матрице требуется не менее 75% известных оценок. Неизвестные значения не заменяются нулём.

validation.design: Split rows 75/25 before fitting; hide 10–15% of originally observed validation cells; fit exclusively on training rows; transform masked validation without refitting. The same split and mask are used for every method.
validation.selection: Fixed method settings; no hyperparameter or method selection is validated by these scores.
validation.scope: Nested row/cell masking, not nested hyperparameter CV. Fixed matrix selected before this experiment; conditional error on randomly hidden known cells, not an estimate of MNAR error or population generalization. Repeated cells/splits overlap; SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.

factor_sensitivity.alignment: Each same-q FA is matched to the mean-imputation reference by maximum absolute Tucker congruence and sign alignment. Quantiles are descriptive across completed datasets; no unaligned axes are averaged and no Rubin pooled-factor inference is claimed.
factor_sensitivity.bounds_note: Only imputed entries are bounded; observed values remain exactly unchanged. Fractional estimates are not rounded into fabricated ratings.
factor_sensitivity.FIML: Not implemented here. Existing FA training uses mean completion; marginalizing missing coordinates for posterior object scores does not turn that training fit into FIML.

russia_block.claim: No excluded thematic variable is reconstructed from office, general factors or other proxies. Insufficient measurement is not evidence for or against a Russia factor.

coverage_expansion: None: retained objects and variables are fixed by unchanged _prepare, using actual observations before any imputation.

existing_preview_comparison.note: A later collection may change the admitted matrix. Old previews are not overwritten or silently treated as the new baseline.

coverage_sensitivity.selection: Remove all currently observed flagged cells, all current completion/coverage_expansion provenance cells, and their union, separately. Flags indicate review limitations, not automatically erroneous measurements.

diagnostics.measurement: independent property intensities 0..5; explicit pole statuses; no subtraction or invented antonyms
diagnostics.missing_policy: unknown is NaN, never zero; iteratively filter scales before objects until stable; training gaps mean-imputed; posterior uses only observed coordinates
diagnostics.minimum_coverage_policy: each iteration: first scales observed on at least 60% and 8 current objects and nonconstant; then objects observed on at least 60% and 4 surviving scales; repeat until stable; retained overall coverage at least 75%
diagnostics.preprocessing_report: На каждой итерации сначала исключаются постоянные шкалы и шкалы, измеренные менее чем у 60% текущих объектов или менее чем у 8 объектов. Затем исключаются объекты с оценками менее чем по 60% оставшихся шкал или менее чем по 4 шкалам. Процедура повторяется до стабильности состава. В итоговой матрице требуется не менее 75% известных оценок. Неизвестные значения не заменяются нулём.
